mix: Near -14 LUFS, true peak <= -1 dBTP. Effects below aligned narration.

new_assets.prompt: Distant turn-of-the-century city street: a few footsteps on pavement, a horse cart passing slowly, low murmur of voices. No car engines, horns, sirens or music.
Wooden shop shutter swung closed and latched once, modest and dry. No slam or metal roll-down.
Two people walking up a few stone steps and a heavy wooden door opening and closing behind them. No bell or hotel chime.
A soft worn leather travel bag set down once on a wooden floor. No zip or wheels.
One heavy ledger page turned slowly on a wooden counter. No paper rustle loop.
A steel-nib pen writing two short words in a ledger, quiet scratch. No typewriter.
A woollen blanket folded by hand, two soft movements. No snap.
Two or three slow footsteps climbing a worn wooden tenement stair, slight creak. No modern shoe squeak.
A foot-treadle sewing machine running steadily, mechanical and quiet, with the treadle rocking. No electric motor hum.
A hot flat iron touched to damp cloth: one short hiss of steam. No kettle whistle.
A covered pot simmering gently on a coal stove with a faint coal crackle. No boiling-over or gas burner.
A heavy flat iron set down once on a padded wooden board, dull thud. No metal ring.
A single iron key placed on a wooden counter. No jangle of a key ring.
A plain interior wooden door closed gently with a latch click. No slam or echo.
Very quiet evening street heard from a doorway or through a closed window: faint distant footsteps and a muffled voice, mostly still. No traffic or music.
